svg.title: Using the simulator to verify the refactor
svg.desc: Three checks: record realistic plan calls on the baseline, replay them offline through both schedulers, and rerun the scenarios closed loop on the candidate.

g.text: Using the simulator to verify the refactor

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Replay checks the scheduler alone on realistic requests and is deterministic; the closed loop checks that the whole stack still behaves, and is not. Dispatch already publishes every plan
